The $536 million requested for FY 2026 will enable FMCSA to promote compliance and safety nationwide through motor carrier safety grant programs. In FY 2026, FMCSA will leverage grant programs to improve commercial motor vehicle safety outcomes. Motor Carrier Safety Operations and Programs. The requested $390 million for Motor Carrier Safety Operations and Programs provides the necessary resources for dedicated FMCSA staff to sustain mission-critical operations, including headquarters and field activities.
